IN THIS STORYWhy UnifiedThe foundationHow it is builtWhat comes next
01 / WHY UNIFIED

Working beside
the thing you’re making.

Useful work often outgrows a conversation. A plan needs to be examined. A draft needs to be revised. A tool needs to be tried.

Amplifier Unified brings conversation, outputs, and supported tools into one workspace. The aim is to make it easier to point at the work, talk about it, and change it together.

Talk it through.
See it take shape.
02 / THE FOUNDATION

More than a model.

A model is one part of the experience. Useful work also needs tools, context, a way to run tasks, and a way to inspect what happened.

Amplifier provides a modular foundation for that work. Unified gives people a connected place to use it: a conversation, a canvas for the result, retained history, and supported controls shared with the agent.

03 / HOW IT IS BUILT

Be clear about
what good looks like.

Unified grew out of the team’s daily work with Amplifier. The development approach uses written intent and explicit contracts to describe what an experience should do and how its pieces should work together.

The resulting software still needs to be inspected, tested, and refined. Reusable components are a stronger starting point; people supply the judgment about whether the result is useful.

Read MADE’s approach to building
04 / WHAT COMES NEXT

A foundation
to keep building on.

The current focus is an approachable personal workspace for capable AI work. Team experiences, richer hosted services, and more connected capabilities are areas of ongoing development.

Those are directions to explore, rather than promises that every integration is ready today.
